start_basis: First observed clock reading in this shared participant run; cases read in one context.
time_observation: Start observed with clock__curr_time; completion observed with Python datetime in UTC during finalization. Cases were interleaved in one participant run, so the shared interval is not separate case execution time.

participant.metadata_limit: Exact inherited runtime settings, token accounting and cost were not exposed; no values inferred from labels or task context.

shared_context.limitation: The three case results are connected work by one participant, not three independent runs. Supplied duplicate skills were read and content-deduplicated across cases. No other participant output, answer key, public guide, source repository or memory file was inspected.
shared_context.reference_transfer: Identity and evidence-state guidance read in the Mars skill copies was also applied to the other two cases; aerospace dependency guidance read there informed the Hubble review.

skills_used.application: Separated observations from proposals; connected technical and organizational consequences and reconsideration conditions.
Kept historical space findings separate from synthetic integration/metrology decisions and avoided invented flight or certification credit.
Specified version/unit ingress, provenance, rejection, downstream effects and human ownership in HG-05.
Challenged the supplied acceptance assertions, retained unresolved claims, and preserved original identities and evidence status. No review guide or answer analysis was read.

tools_used.use: Orchestrated allowed tools; batched independent reads/retrievals and inspections.
Observed shared start UTC and later checkpoint.
Bash commands in allowed workspace; rg file inventory; Python 3 standard-library reads, SHA256, CSV/JSON creation, structural checks and timestamps.
Opened only primary URLs supplied in sources.json; find/open within those URLs. No search engine query or linked secondary source used.
Sent the assigning parent a progress update; no other participant information requested or inspected.

sources_used.local: request.md, review-task.md, packet-manifest.json, source-facts.csv, interfaces.csv, claim-evidence.csv, change.json, relations.mmd, sources.json, and listed supplied skill content.

remote.access: Retrieved and inspected web-tool extracted text from executive summary pp. 6-8 and relevant section 4/5 passages; find results included the ground-software unit definition and training/verification findings.
remote.limits: No complete historical interface, raw navigation data, or synthetic test implementation recovered; no raw PDF bytes downloaded or SHA256 claimed.

actions_not_performed: No engineering test or trial executed
No fixture, software ingress or airport service changed
No real approval or acceptance issued
No paid API, global installation or production action
No public review guide or case answer analysis sought

exceptions.observed: Initial read command exited 127 with python: command not found.
exceptions.handling: Used available python3 successfully; no installation attempted.

exceptions.event: omitted public guide and README link
exceptions.observed: review-task.md links to omitted review-guide.md and README.md; request.md explicitly directs use of sources.json and prohibits seeking the guide/answer analysis.
exceptions.handling: Used supplied source register and selected skills. Did not seek omitted material.

exceptions.observed: The first combined primary-source/skill return exceeded displayed output budget.
exceptions.handling: Targeted follow-up opens exposed all Heathrow paragraphs relied upon; MCO find results exposed relevant verification passages. No claim of full-PDF inspection.

exceptions.event: unknown runtime metadata and remote raw-byte hashes
exceptions.handling: Recorded unknown/null explicitly rather than inferred values.

exceptions.event: role assignments and technical thresholds absent
exceptions.handling: Named proposed accountable roles; retained unavailable criteria and evidence as gaps. No fictitious owner appointment, tolerances, throughput or executed result.

output_hash_policy.scope: All finalized output payload files other than run-record.json and run-record.sha256.
output_hash_policy.self_reference_exclusion: A digest cannot include itself without a circular dependency; the digest sidecar is not self-hashed.
